subject: Stop the trial above 70% utilization because user harm begins at 70%.
rationale: The proposition presents a prospective stopping rule with a coherent trigger and action. However, it asserts empirical harm onset at 70% without supporting observations or a validated causal model. The frozen conditions explicitly state that 70% has not been empirically calibrated. Authoring that threshold does not establish harm onset, so the stated empirical justification violates the contract.
